desc:
🎬 From casting call to Hollywood superstar – write your own movie star story!

Start as an unknown newcomer, nail your auditions and land your first roles. Act in commercials, comedies, horror films, action blockbusters and sci-fi epics – run, jump, dodge and shoot your way through every scene!

⭐ Earn fame and money with every film
🏆 Walk the red carpet, attend premieres and win awards
🎥 Build your own film studio and produce blockbusters
🏡 Move from a tiny apartment to a luxury villa in the Hollywood Hills
🚗 Buy cars, limousines – and even a real flying car!
👗 Dress up in glamorous outfits for your big moments
🤝 Play with friends: ride along, party and compete as rivals

How far will YOU go? From Newcomer to Hollywood Icon – the spotlight is waiting!

New updates coming regularly. Like ⭐ the game to stay tuned!
